excerpt: Swiggy is a Bengaluru food delivery and quick-commerce company (Instamart, Dineout, Swiggy One), listed on the NSE and BSE since November 2024.
content:
Swiggy is an Indian convenience platform best known for restaurant food delivery. Its corporate site says it launched food delivery in 2014 and quick commerce in 2020, and has since added Instamart and Genie (2020), the Swiggy One membership (2021), Dineout, which it acquired in 2022, Swiggy Minis (2022), a co-branded HDFC Bank credit card (2023), and Bolt and Swiggy Scenes (2024). The same page says the platform crossed 120 million ever-transacting users in 2025.

Inc42 reported that Swiggy was founded in 2014 by Sriharsha Majety, Nandan Reddy and Rahul Jaimini. Jaimini stepped back from his role as cofounder and CTO in May 2020 to cofound the edtech company Pesto, staying on as a shareholder and board member. Swiggy's corporate site lists Majety as Managing Director and Group CEO, Rohit Kapoor as CEO of the food marketplace and Rahul Bothra as CFO, and says Nandita Sinha became CEO of Instamart from 3 August 2026.

Swiggy went public in November 2024. Entrepreneur India reported a price band of INR 371 to INR 390 a share and a total issue of about INR 11,327.43 crore, made up of a INR 4,499 crore fresh issue and an offer for sale by existing shareholders. Business Today reported that the shares listed on 13 November 2024 at Rs 420 on the NSE, 7.69% above the Rs 390 issue price, and at Rs 412 on the BSE.

For customers, Swiggy is a free app: you pay for the food or groceries you order plus any delivery, platform or packaging charges shown at checkout. The paid Swiggy One membership adds delivery and discount benefits; its price is shown in the app rather than on a public pricing page. This profile is put together from the company's own pages and published reporting. We have not tested the product for this page, and nothing here is paid placement.

profile.summary_short: Food delivery, Instamart quick commerce and Dineout table booking in one app

team.role: Cofounder, Managing Director and Group CEO

team.name: Rahul Jaimini

use_cases: Getting groceries and household items delivered in minutes through Instamart
Booking a restaurant table and dining offers through Dineout
Bundling delivery benefits across food and Instamart with a Swiggy One membership

fit: live in one of the Indian cities Swiggy serves and want restaurant food delivered
want groceries and essentials in one app alongside food
order often enough that a delivery membership could pay for itself
not_fit: live outside India: Swiggy is an India-only service
want a fixed price list before installing: fees and membership prices are shown in the app

pricing.intro: Swiggy does not publish a price list on its website. The app is free; each order shows the item prices and any delivery, platform or packaging fees at checkout. The price of the Swiggy One membership is shown in the app.

plans.name: Swiggy app
plans.detail: Pay per order; fees shown at checkout

plans.name: Swiggy One membership
plans.detail: Delivery and discount benefits across food and Instamart; launched in 2021 per Swiggy's corporate timeline

notes: We could not find an official public page listing current Swiggy One prices, so none are quoted here.

pros: Food, quick commerce, dining out and events in one account
Large network: Swiggy reports 120 million+ ever-transacting users (2025)
Listed company, so financial results are public through stock-exchange filings
cons: Fees and membership prices are only visible inside the app

alternatives.intro: Other ways to get food or groceries delivered in India. We have not compared prices, which change by city and order.

items.name: Zomato
items.what: Restaurant discovery and food delivery app
items.difference: Swiggy's closest rival in food delivery; Blinkit, from the same group, competes with Instamart.

items.name: Zepto
items.difference: Groceries only; no restaurant food delivery.

items.name: Blinkit
items.difference: Competes with Instamart rather than Swiggy's food business.

items.name: Magicpin
items.what: Local offers and food delivery app
items.difference: Smaller food-delivery player focused on local merchant offers.

faq.a: Sriharsha Majety, Nandan Reddy and Rahul Jaimini, in 2014, according to Inc42. Majety is the Managing Director and Group CEO.
Yes. Its shares listed on the NSE and BSE on 13 November 2024 after an IPO priced at Rs 390 a share.
Swiggy's quick-commerce service for groceries and household items, launched in 2020.

faq.q: How much does Swiggy One cost?
faq.a: Swiggy shows the membership price in its app; we did not find an official public price page, so we don't quote one.
